verdict.rationale: Anrok's 'AI Atlas' is explicitly described as answering sales-tax questions 'with the reasoning shown, grounded in your own transactions, registrations, filings, and certificates' — a purpose-built tax AI over its own rule/data base rather than a generic chatbot. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of answer accuracy, detail on invoice-level 'why did this tax this way' explanations, and citation format specifics.
